职位介绍
    职位描述： 你来解决什么问题 水滴公司目前在日常工作中已经大量引入AI Agent进行协同办公，我们希望找到一个人，在未来规模继续扩大之前，把Agent的安全规范、风险管控、技术防线等安全基础设施系统性地建起来。 你将负责： 1、主导AI Agent安全体系从0到1建设，包含网络安全、数据安全等维度； 2、通过技术手段识别和管控安全风险——权限边界设计、数据流管控、异常行为检测，不仅是靠规范文件约束； 3、持续识别员工使用agent过程中的安全薄弱点，输出技术评估和管控方案 以小组协作方式推进安全能力建设，统筹分工。 职位要求： 我们在找什么样的人： 1、资深研发背景，有安全领域真实项目经验（信息安全 / 数据安全 / 权限认证管控等方向均可）； 2、有企业级安全体系建设经验，且对AI agent风险有系统性认知——理解提示词注入、权限滥用与越权、沙箱隔离等Agent场景的安全风险和防范手段； 3、熟悉企业数据安全管控的常用方法； 4、深度理解LLM / agent原理； 5、有小团队管理经验优先。 加分项 1、大型互联网公司安全方向，或AI原生公司安全 / 治理岗背景 2、有企业级AI安全治理完整落地经历 AI能力要求 agent是你的日常主力工具，不是偶尔用一下。我们要的不是会用工具，而是真正理解agent在企业场景下的能力边界——哪里能放、哪里必须管、为什么——能把安全认知和实际使用结合起来。 为什么值得考虑 1、水滴员工AI工具使用率在互联网公司里属于头部，这个岗位面对的是真实、规模化的问题，不是务虚； 2、从零建体系，有完整的主导空间； 3、直接参与公司AI治理决策链。 

其他信息
    行业要求：全部行业
## 公

title: 第八条：本地政府、监管理解与法律法规合规 信息安全很多时候可以看做是最接近武侠小说中“江湖“的概念，但”江湖“从来不是法外之地，知法、懂法、尊法、用法是最基本的要求。随着国际化的不断深入，中国企业走出去、国外企业走进来都离不开法律法规的遵循与合理运用，更进一步来说一些业界最佳实践、国际标准、行业指南不应该仅仅是简单的符合要求，更能成为企业基本能力的公允说明、重视程度的态度表达和沟通协作的统一”语言界面“。 在国内开展信息安全相关工作，一些基本要求需要得到有效关注与落实，如2017年6月1日实施的《网络安全法》以及配套的系列法规要求；刑法285、286条款以配套司法解释；信息系统等级保护相关的系列；《个人信息安全保护规范》；各行业主管机构的相关要求。全球开展业务中，数据与隐私保护会是面临的主要挑战，如GDPR（欧盟通用数据保护方案）、HIPAA（Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act）等最为代表。另外，在互联网、金融、能源、资源型等行业，各国对基础设施方面的保护法案与要求也面临规范与日趋严厉。 | Simon Wu

**Role Summary
**Applied Materials has an exciting opportunity for an experienced program management professional to join a growing team. We are a leading semiconductor manufacturing equipment supplier, renowned for our cutting-edge technology and commitment to excellence. As we continue to expand our operations, we are seeking a highly skilled and experienced PMO Professional to support our Product Regulatory Compliance program. This critical role ensures our products meet all applicable regulatory requirements and industry standards, enabling us to maintain our reputation as a trusted provider of high-quality equipment.
This position requires excellent organizational skills, PowerPoint skills, communication skills, attention to detail, and keen judgment for prioritization and execution in a fast-paced environment.
This role will be based out of Applied Materials’ office in Austin, TX.
**Key Responsibilities
**
* Support and oversee the overall Product Regulatory Compliance program, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and objectives.
* Develop and implement a comprehensive compliance strategy and roadmap, including goals, objectives, timelines, and resource allocation.
* Stay up to date with evolving global regulatory requirements and industry standards, ensuring compliance across all relevant areas.
* Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to conduct thorough risk assessments to identify potential compliance risks and develop effective mitigation strategies.
* Establish and maintain a centralized repository for compliance-related documentation, ensuring accuracy, accessibility, and adherence to document control processes.
* Lead the preparation and presentation of compliance reports, status updates, and progress documentation to executive leadership and stakeholders.
* Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including product development, engineering, legal, and regulatory affairs, to ensure compliance requirements are integrated into product design and development processes.
* Implement and continuously improve compliance processes, procedures, and tools to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.
* Provide leadership and mentorship to the compliance team, overseeing their work and ensuring their professional development.
* Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SME’s) to provide oversight and ensure the implementation of necessary changes to comply with new or updated regulations, standards, and industry best practices.
* Collaborate with internal teams to assess and address product compliance-related issues in the supply chain, including trade and finance considerations.
**Functional Knowledge
**
* Broad understanding of risk management principles and practices related to compliance.
* In-depth knowledge of global regulatory requirements, such as RoHS, REACH, WEEE, and other relevant product compliance regulations.
* Extensive knowledge of legal and compliance frameworks applicable to manufacturing and the semiconductor industry.
* A strong foundation in semiconductor technology, including knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
* Familiarity with quality management systems (e.g., ISO 9001) and their associated compliance requirements.
**Project Management
**
* Proven experience in leading teams in complex projects, preferably in the field of product regulatory compliance.
* Strong project planning, execution, and resource management skills.
* Proficient in project management methodologies (Six Sigma, Agile, Scrum) and tools (MS Project, JIRA) to effectively manage complex projects .
**Leadership
**
* Demonstrated ability to lead and inspire cross-functional teams to achieve compliance goals.
* Excellent decision-making and problem-solving capabilities.
* Strong ability to influence and drive change at all levels of the organization.
**Problem Solving
**
* Experienced analytical mindset with the ability to identify compliance-related issues and develop effective solutions.
* Proficient in conducting risk assessments and developing risk mitigation strategies.
**Change Management
**
* Proven ability to lead organizational change initiatives related to compliance requirements.
* In-depth experience in developing and leading teams through implementation of change management strategies.
**Interpersonal Skills
**
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively communicate complex compliance concepts to diverse stakeholders.
* Proven negotiation and conflict resolution skills.
* Solid ability to build and maintain strong relationships with internal teams and external partners.
**Legal/Compliance/Trade
**
* Strong understanding of legal and compliance frameworks relevant to the semiconductor industry.
* In-depth knowledge of trade regulations and requirements applicable to manufacturing industries.
**Supply Chain
**
* Extensive experience of supply chain management principles and practices, with a focus on compliance considerations.
**Finance
**
* Proven ability to analyze and interpret financial implications of compliance requirements.
**Education
**
* Bachelor's Degree required (Engineering/Manufacturing/Business)
* Master’s Degree preferred.
**Additional Qualifications
**
* Professional certifications such as Project Management Professional (PMP), Program Management Professional (PgMP), and Certified Regulatory Compliance Manager (CRCM) are highly desirable.
**Years Of Experience
**
* 15+ Years professional experience required.
* 10+ Years of experience in project management, compliance, or a related field, with a focus on product regulatory compliance within the semiconductor or manufacturing industry.

description:
# American Express is hiring for Analyst-Privacy Compliance 26010490 for Gurugram location. This role will expire by 21-Jul-2026 1:30 PM. | Kirandeep Singh · LinkedIn · 2026-07-09

**Kirandeep Singh**: Regulatory Compliance Manager at American Express with 10 years 10 months of experience. Previous roles include Senior Compliance Officer Regulatory Change Management Program office at American Express, Compliance officer Compliance Risk Assessment Program office at American Express, and Lead Business Analyst at American Express. Based in Gurgaon, Haryana, India [IN].

---

American Express is hiring for Analyst-Privacy Compliance 26010490 for Gurugram location. This role will expire by 21-Jul-2026 1:30 PM.

Responsibilities
Provide independent privacy risk oversight for Merchant and Commercial privacy activities across International.
Support the monitoring, analysis, and reporting of privacy key risk indicators and other privacy risk management data.
Partner with Compliance and other stakeholders to oversee privacy legal and regulatory change management activities.
Foster a culture of privacy at American Express by advocating for privacy-by-design, integration of the American Express Data Protection & Privacy Principles, accountability, and sharing of best practices.

Qualifications
Minimum qualifications:
2 years hands-on privacy experience and knowledge of international Privacy-related regulations & current trends.
Familiarity with American Express’ closed loop model and the payments industry, particularly B2B products and services.
Strong analytical capabilities.
Highly organized with strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
Ability to build relationships, influence stakeholders, mobilize cross-functional and regional teams, and work independently.

Preferred Additional:
Privacy certification (e.g. CIPP/E, CIPP/M).
Prior work in compliance, audit, and/or risk management experience in a financial services, digital, or technology company.
Knowledge of Internet and digital technologies (e.g., alternative payments, mobile apps, online advertising, tracking technologies, social media, and large data sets, with a focus on personal data flows).

**Rizwanullah B**: Rizwanullah B has held roles including Vice President Service Delivery at 3i Infotech Ltd., Account Manager at Sutherland Global Services Ltd, and Application Support Engineer at Slash Support.. Based in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India [IN].

---

We’re Hiring | IBM Guardium Data Protection – L2 Support Engineer
📍 Location: Chennai
🧠 Experience: 4–7 Years (2–3 Years hands-on with IBM Guardium)
We are looking for a skilled IBM Guardium Data Protection (GDP) L2 Support Engineer to manage, support, and optimize enterprise data security environments. The role focuses on advanced troubleshooting, policy management, compliance support, and operational stability of IBM Guardium platforms.
🔧 Key Responsibilities
L2 support for IBM Guardium (Collectors, Aggregators, Central Manager)
Troubleshooting STAP/S-TAP/K-TAP, agent communication & traffic capture issues
Monitor system health (CPU, memory, disk, network)
Configure DAM policies, alerts, real-time blocking & audit rules
Support compliance: PCI-DSS, SOX, GDPR, HIPAA
Generate audit reports & compliance dashboards
Perform upgrades, patching, backup & DR testing
Incident handling, RCA & coordination with IBM support
SIEM integrations (Splunk, QRadar, ArcSight)
Automation using CLI / APIs
🛠 Mandatory Skills
Strong hands-on experience with IBM Guardium Data Protection
STAP, S-TAP, K-TAP expertise
Linux/UNIX administration & Guardium CLI
Database & SQL knowledge
Networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, ports, SSL/TLS)
ITIL / ServiceNow experience
⭐ Good to Have
Guardium Insights / Discover & Classify
Cloud exposure (AWS / Azure / GCP)
Shell / Python scripting
IBM Guardium certification
📩 Interested candidates can apply or share their profile to rizwanullah.b@3i-infotech.com
🔖 Hashtags
#Hiring #IBMGuardium #DataSecurity #DatabaseSecurity #DAM
#CyberSecurityJobs #L2Support #ITJobs #ChennaiJobs
#InformationSecurity #Compliance #Guardium #TechCareers

title: 将网络安全事件纳入反洗钱 (AML) 制度： 将网络安全事件纳入反洗钱 (AML) 制度：在为人工智能和机器学习感到振奋之际，也要考虑技术的运用带来的风险和威胁。对于跟随潮流，将技术视为解决成本问题、提升客户参与度、开发客户的灵丹妙药的机构来说，一定要充分意识到，如果不实施有效的制度和协议，技术有可能对客户信息和一般制度安全造成风险和威胁。在亚洲，随着微信支付、支付宝等移动钱包和无现金支付手段加速普及，金融机构必须进一步加强数据和系统安全协议，以组成有效的反洗钱合规制度。 | Meihang Li

title: 第十一条：组织架构、安全意识与内部安全品牌建设 前面大部分内容讨论的是各项管理、技术能力的建设，能不能落地，很大程度上依赖与团队与人，合理的组织架构可以最大化的发挥人的价值，反过来有可能极大的削弱与限制，这个道理大部分领导者都懂，但是不是能实际做到就是另外一回事了，环境限制、时机甚至个人决断力都是容易打折的因素。 组织架构的设置可以从几个方面考虑： 战场布局方式，“战区主战、军种主建、军委管总“。战区主战，安全团队与能力应该融入业务与技术环境的一线，不应该是自娱自乐的闭门造车，安全能力能不能前出到这里，考验的是团队中综合能力人员的配比，能谈技术、能懂业务、能搞安全，这类人可以部署在战区，也就是业务与技术实际环境中，融入业务与技术战场，快速联动，贴身肉搏。能把业务线、技术线的发展规划、诉求、对接能力要求等战场态势实时回传到后续支持防线，同时把安全能力、管控要求投放到业务实际中。军种主建，各安全业务方向，如信息安全、数据安全、业务安全等等，应做好各自的工具、系统、平台，构建各种方法、框架、体系，全面提升所属方向的作战实力，为前线提供弹药、装备、情报，同时协调资源，完成战役级的指挥、综合保障以及跨兵种协同等，提供大中后台的整合作战能力。军委管总，战略规划能力、资源投放协调能力、风险优化能力等等考验格局与”大国“战略视角，一个公司的信息安全能不能发挥出价值，能不能体现出来业务的安全感，往往需要从全局观上发挥作用，”不怒而威、刚柔并济“。 （第十一条未完待续） | Simon Wu

### Laurent Halimi 

#### Founder & CEO | CYBERR® | The Professional Network For Cybersecurity

 

Are you a talented Security Engineer looking to make an impact in the cybersecurity space? CYBERR, the leading platform connecting top cybersecurity professionals with forward-thinking organizations, is actively seeking multiple Security Engineers to join various leading companies in the industry. This is your chance to work with cutting-edge technologies, enhance your career, and contribute to safeguarding the digital world.

At CYBERR, we are redefining how cybersecurity talent and companies connect. Our platform is trusted by the world’s top organizations, from startups to enterprises, in their mission to strengthen and secure their digital ecosystems. Join us to work on diverse and challenging projects, where you’ll be part of a vibrant community of cybersecurity professionals driving the future of security.

We are hiring Security Engineers for multiple leading companies. Positions are remote with global opportunities available. Roles include Junior Security Engineer, Security Engineer, Senior Security Engineer, and Security Engineer specializing in Cloud, Infrastructure, Network, and Application Security.

As a Security Engineer, your key responsibilities will include designing and implementing security measures to protect networks, systems, and data across various organizations. You’ll be expected to monitor and respond to security incidents, including identifying vulnerabilities, mitigating risks, and investigating threats. You’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams to build and maintain secure systems, infrastructures, and applications, and conduct security assessments and vulnerability assessments to identify and remediate weaknesses. Additionally, you will develop and enforce security policies, procedures, and best practices to ensure compliance with industry regulations and frameworks such as NIST, ISO, and GDPR. Performing penetration testing to evaluate the effectiveness of security defenses and recommending improvements will also be a key part of the role. Finally, staying up-to-date on the latest threats, vulnerabilities, and security trends to proactively defend against emerging risks will be a priority.

To qualify, you should have strong experience in network security, systems security, application security, or cloud security. You should be proficient with security tools and technologies such as firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPNs, SIEM, and endpoint protection. Familiarity with penetration testing, vulnerability scanning, and incident response is essential. Experience in cloud security (AWS, Azure, GCP) is a plus. A solid understanding of security frameworks and standards like NIST, ISO 27001, and CIS will be beneficial. Additionally, experience with scripting or automation (Python, Bash, PowerShell) is desirable. Certifications like CISSP, CISM, CEH, or other relevant credentials are also a plus. Above all, we’re looking for a passion for cybersecurity, continuous learning, and problem-solving.

At CYBERR, we offer competitive salary and benefits packages, including remote positions with flexible work hours. You’ll have access to mentorship, training, and numerous career development opportunities within the CYBERR community. Join us and work on impactful projects that safeguard critical digital infrastructures for top-tier organizations. Be part of a dynamic team of cybersecurity professionals who share your passion for innovation and security.

If you’re ready to challenge yourself, work with top-tier companies, and make a real difference in the fight against cyber threats, CYBERR wants to hear from you! Apply today to join the cybersecurity community of the future.

课程介绍
隐私体系管理是一项指导性培训，主要涵盖以下各项:落实隐私项目框架、管理隐私项目的运作生命周期，并构建一支知识渊博、表现优异的隐私团队。无论身处哪一管辖区域或是从事哪一行业，参加此课程者都将学习通过流程与技术来管理组织隐私的技能。 
隐私项目管理培训以 IAPP 的 ANSI 知识体系为基础-获得公认的注册隐私信息管理经理(CIPM)资质认证项目。 
课程大纲
模块 1:隐私体系管理简介 
明确与隐私项目管理相关的责任，阐述问责制在隐私项目管理中所发挥的作用。 
模块 2:隐私治理 
探究制定和实施隐私项目的注意事项，包括隐私职能部门在组织中的地位、DPO 的作用、项目范围与章程、隐私策略，以及对于关键职能和隐私框架的支持和持续性参与。 
模块 3:适用的法律法规 
探讨监管环境、不同管辖区域的共同要素，以及与组织战略保持一致的策略。 
模块 4:数据评估 
介绍创建和使用数据库存/数据映射、差距分析、隐私评估、隐私影响评估/数据保护影响评估，以及供应商评估的实际流程。 
模块 5:政策 
阐述与隐私相关之策略的常见类型，概述各相关组件，并提供了实施策略。 
模块 6:数据主体权利 
探讨传达和确保数据主体权利的操作注意事项，包括隐私通知、选择权与同意权、查阅权与更正权、数据迁移权，以及删除权。 
模块 7:培训与宣导 
概述制定和实施隐私培训及宣导项目的策略。 
模块 8:保护个人信息 
研究通过隐私设计来保护个人信息的整体方法。 
模块 9:数据泄露事故响应计划 
为规划和应对数据安全事故或泄露提供指导。 
模块 10:监控与审计项目绩效 
介绍监控、衡量、分析和审计隐私项目绩效的常用做法。

Company ProfileMorgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, investment management and wealth management services. The Firm's employees serve clients worldwide including corporations, governments and individuals from more than 747 offices in 42 countries.As a market leader, the talent and passion of our people is critical to our success. Together, we share a common set of values rooted in integrity, excellence and strong team ethic. Morgan Stanley can provide a superior foundation for building a professional career - a place for people to learn, to achieve and grow. A philosophy that balances personal lifestyles, perspectives and needs is an important part of our culture.Department ProfileMorgan Stanley's Institutional Securities Group (ISG) is a remarkably broad and diversified business. We provide institutions with almost every kind of financial product and service across the world's major markets. Whether one’s interested in planning complex deals; trading on the moment-to-moment movements of the capital markets; analysing the financial needs of a company or a wealthy family, Morgan Stanley is the place to be.The Securities Lending Trading Team handles the centralized management and governance of Morgan Stanley’s global securities financing and OTC derivatives activities. Morgan Stanley’s clients include leading hedge funds, asset managers, banks and institutional investors.The successful candidate will join the IED Securities Lending Trading Team, managing the risk and profitability of a designated trading book and taking ownership of supply-side relationships trading across multiple financing products. The team sits in a fast-paced trading environment with connectivity to clients and firm trading desks.Primary Responsibilities

- Risk management, positioning and ongoing optimization of the equity financing books
- Idea generation, positioning and risk management around corporate actions
- Synthetic sourcing through delta one derivatives
- Pricing new and existing business including overnight, term transactions and exclusive portfolios
- Managing and growing external lender relationships
- Providing expert commentary to both external and internal clients on a single name and sector-level
- Daily P&L reconciliation/book management and maintenance
- Close interaction with related business units to maximize franchise value
- Building solid relationships with partner areas such as legal & compliance, risk, operations and technology

Skills Required (essential)

- Experience working within securities finance or a comparable trading environment
- Experience in equity derivatives and cash trading are highly preferred
- Outstanding analytical and quantitative skills
- Attention to detail
- Must be an excellent team player with a strong work ethic
- Ability to multi-task in a high-pressure environment
- Strong interpersonal/relationship-building skills
- An entrepreneurial and innovative approach and a risk-aware attitude
- Presentation skills and confidence in telephone, written and face-to-face interactions
- Strong communication skills (written & oral) English (mandatory), and proficiency in Mandarin or Korean
- Proficiency in Python, previous data analytics/basic programming experience preferred

title: 隐私条款
description:
51job.com强调保护所有会员的隐私权，我们将为每个会员提供最安全，最可靠的服务。您可以通过无忧工作网51job.com完全控制自己的个人信息。以下是我们的承诺： 
### 会员信息
当您到我们网站上注册并填写简历的时候，您会被要求提供一系列个人基本信息，如您的姓名、地址、电子邮件、电话号码等等。除非我们认为出于法律的需要，我们不会向第三方公开上述信息。但这些资料将会被我们统计、汇总，为我们的广告商提供依据。 
### 关于简历
51job为您的简历提供三种控制权限，当你在填写简历时就可以设置个人简历控制权限： 
### 对所有公开
允许51job.com的专业人员和通过51job.com审核的用人单位有权使用我们的简历库搜索到您的简历。如果您希望得到最全面的求职服务——职位推荐、面试邀约、求职秘籍等，这项服务将更适合您。 
### 对无忧开放
只允许51job.com的专业人员或认证猎头人士使用我们的简历库搜索到您的简历。我们会为您的工作经历来为您推荐高质量的职位，但会在开放简历前询问您的意愿。51job.com的专业人员也会不定期的与您联系，届时会与您确认您的最新求职意向并为您提供更多符合您的职业发展机会。 
### 完全保密
您可以在51job.com上填写简历，并自行查找职位和投递简历。您的个人信息不会被任何人员（包括并不限于51job的专业人员、用人单位）搜索到，所有的信息完全保密。 但如果您希望能接受面试邀约或职位推荐，我们建议您更改此选项，将简历公开度设定为“对所有公开”。 
### 个人公共档案
51job的个人会员拥有一个个人公共档案，包括职位名称、公司名称、居住地、行业等工作经验和教育经历的部分信息，但不包含姓名、联系方式等隐私信息。这个公共档案可以被51job会员（包括个人会员或企业会员）查询。  
个人公共档案有2种控制权限，你可以在相关的功能中进行设置： 
### 公开（默认）
51job会员（包括个人会员或企业会员）可以查询你的公共档案，并可以通过发私信与你联系（通过51job站内信的方式）。 
### 不公开
你的公共档案不会被任何人包括51job.com在内的其他人员检索到，信息完全保密。 
### 公共论坛
51job.com为访问者提供论坛、BBS等。如果您访问这些区域，您公布的任何信息都会成为公共信息。51job.com提醒您慎重考虑！另外，您在这些区域发表言论及/或发布信息都属个人行为，不代表51job.com的立场，51job.com不对此类个人言论及个人行为承担任何 负责。 
### 信息的修改和删除
您可以在51job.com上自由修改您的个人信息和简历。除了信息的发布者外，任何人无权修改或删除他人发布的信息。51job.com有权根据其判断保留修改或删除任何不适信息的权利。 
### 隐私权条款的变更
如果我们决定改变51job.com的隐私权条款，我们会在此公布，以便您能及时了解到我们在收集什么资料，如何使用这些资料，以及是否向别人公开这些资料。如果您有任何关于我 们隐私权条款的问题，欢迎您随时给我们发电子邮件至 privacy@51job.com。

# What does it mean to be a Salesforce Native app?

#### Forbes 30 under 30 | Co-founder & CEO Venizum |
Published Mar 1, 2024
[+ Follow](https://www.linkedin.com/signup/cold-join?session_redirect=/pulse/what-does-mean-salesforce-native-app-maziar-nodehi-rb5de&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_publisher-author-card)
### Eexecutive Summary
Salesforce native applications have emerged as a gold standard in customer relationship management (CRM). Designed to integrate with Salesforce seamlessly,Verbiswas created from the beginning as a native app to offer unmatched data security, which is a critical consideration for organizations looking to protect their valuable information. In this short article, we’ll delve into the inherent security advantages of Salesforce native applications and why they’re the top choice for Enterprise customers.
The Rarity of Native Apps
It’s important to note that while the Salesforce AppExchange boasts thousands of apps, only a small fraction can be classified as “native.” In fact, only about15%of the7000+apps live on the AppExchange are native. This is because native apps adhere to a strict definition, requiring them to be entirely constructed on Salesforce without external dependencies.
### Understanding Salesforce Native Applications
Before we explore the exceptional data security provided by Salesforce native apps, let’s first define what they are. A Salesforce Native App is 100% built and hosted within Salesforce, utilizing Salesforce’s core technologies such as Lightning Web Components (LWC) and Aura components. These apps operate exclusively within Salesforce and have no servers and storages on their own.
Security from a Data Perspective
When it comes to data security, Salesforce native applications shine for several reasons:
1. Data Stays in Salesforce: Native apps ensure that all your data remains securely within your Salesforce Org. There is no external storage of your data by the app provider or any third parties. This means that no additional security reviews are needed beyond your company’s Salesforce review.
2. Salesforce’s Robust Security Measures: Native apps benefit from the comprehensive security measures already in place within Salesforce. This includes stringent network security, data encryption during transit, intrusion detection systems, regular penetration testing, and vulnerability scans. Data remains within Salesforce-owned data centers, which are meticulously monitored and protected.
3. Compliance Certifications: Salesforce holds a multitude of data security certifications, including GDPR, HIPAA, ISO 27001/27017/27018, and more. Native apps are automatically covered by the security controls mandated by these certifications.
4. Reliability and Disaster Recovery: Salesforce’s reliability measures, such as redundant components and disaster recovery procedures, extend to native applications. Your data is stored on redundant, carrier-class disk storage and is automatically replicated in real-time, ensuring data integrity.
5. Data Control: Salesforce allows customers to configure security controls to protect their org from insider threats and ensure data privacy. Native applications fully respect these customer-configured security controls.

### Physical Security
Salesforce’s data centers boast robust physical security, with authorized personnel access, 2-factor access screening, environmental monitoring, and backup power systems. This level of security extends to native Salesforce apps.
### Data Return or Deletion
Should your organization decide to move away from Salesforce, native apps ensure that your data never leaves the platform. You can request a return of all data, which will be permanently deleted after the contract termination.
### Why Salesforce Native Apps Excel in Data Security
In a world where data protection is paramount, Salesforce native applications offer a distinct advantage. They leverage the formidable data security practices of Salesforce itself, ensuring that your data is never processed outside your Salesforce org. With the backing of robust security measures, compliance certifications, and reliability protocols, native apps offer a level of data security that is second to none.
Businesses in security-conscious industries, such as healthcare, government, and financial services, gravitate towards Salesforce for these very reasons. Native Salesforce apps such as Verbis align seamlessly with these industries’ strict security requirements.
In conclusion, when it comes to securing your critical business data, Salesforce native applications stand out as the premier choice. Their ability to harness the data security prowess of Salesforce, combined with a range of compliance certifications, makes them the go-to solution for organizations committed to safeguarding their information.

title: Recruiting - IP Transport Networks!
description:
Recruiting - IP Transport Networks!

Agree & Join LinkedIn

By clicking Continue to join or sign in, you agree to LinkedIn’s User Agreement, Privacy Policy, and Cookie Policy.

## IP Solution Architect

As the tech firm that created the mobile world, and with more than 54,000 patents to our name, we’ve made it our business to make a mark. When joining our team at Ericsson you are empowered to learn, lead and perform at your best, shaping the future of technology. This is a place where you're welcomed as your own perfectly unique self, and celebrated for the skills, talent, and perspective you bring to the team. Are you in?

Come, and be where it begins.

## Who we are!

Connected devices are everywhere - in factories, fields, city streets and remote villages. But without reliable connectivity, it's just a device. That's why we built our IoT platform - an easy to use solution that provides global connectivity management enabling any enterprise to achieve infinite connectivity. Now any business can connect and handle devices easily, securely, and globally. Ericsson IoT Accelerator handles global IoT connectivity with reliability, security, and cost-efficiency. As the only global platform with a dedicated core network, it provides outstanding scalability, quality of service and unified user experience for IoT deployments of any size, anywhere in the world.

We are responsible for the development and maintenance of M2M features found in IOTA like SIM ordering, M2M provisioning, subscription management as well as rating/billing for Operators or their Enterprises. IOTA supports 2G, 3G, 4G and 5G NSA messaging and packet switched services. IOTA development the features that build up the actual services exposed on our platform whilst the day to day running of that platform (Production) is handled by our colleagues in the NOC.

The Ericsson IOTA solution consists of two areas, Device Connectivity System (DCS) and Business Support Systems (BSS). We want to strengthen the DCS team with more IP Networking (MPBN) experience.

In DCS, we have both Ericsson products, such as STP, EPG, vEPG, UDC (HLR-FE, CUDB, PG), LTE (HSS-FE, DSC), MPBN including IPWORKS, SAPC and 3PP, such as SMSC from Sinch and OSIX probes from Polystar.

## Our Excellent Opportunity

As a Solution Architect in BTEB IOT, you will be working in the forefront of technology and will be involved in projects with many diverse customers around the world. In this role, you will ensure the development of creative and driven technical solutions, products and/or components using the most appropriate technology available across the area of core network E2E functionality. Deep knowledge and insight into 5GC & EPC functionality and node interworking in an end-to-end perspective, both from 3GPP standardization as well as product realization perspective, are encouraged from the applicant.

## You will

- Act as domain specialist in IP Network area providing network solutions considering E2E impacts and optimization of the existing networks.
- Design solutions that are scalable, robust and efficient that fulfills customers technical and business requirements.
- Dimension and analyze node and systems capacity
- Perform proactive reviews of the current architecture and configuration to ensure the best security practices and standards are always applied.
- Construct and update system architecture descriptions and blueprints (HLD, LLD)
- Participate and drive various types of system studies
- Construct roadmaps together with Product Management
- Support in responding to internal and customer questions
- Operation and maintenance on IOTA environment
- Plan, execute and support in upgrades and updates.
- Experience in working in a dynamic and fast paced technical environment

## To be successful in the role you have

The successful you have a blend of skills required to contribute in delivery processes, use of consulting methodology and development of the technical expertise across the team. Also, we trust the candidates to have a proven track record of system design, system integration or equivalent experience. In general, the requirements could sum up to have

- Degree in Electrical, Electronics or Telecommunications Engineering or IT
- Experience in crafting sophisticated, distributed, secure and scalable architecture solutions within large organizations
- Deep technical knowledge of the IP protocols and flow design (MPLS, VPN, BGP) together with knowledge of the IP Backbone (routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers)
- Technical knowledge of F5 Products including LTM / GTM
- Experience in Juniper products/applications (FW/SR) including virtualized (vSRX, vMx)
- Experience in 3PP FW/SR/Security gateways is a plus.
- Ability to understand customers business objectives and be able to link them to improvements in Network Performance and End User Experience
- Recommended certifications:

## Additional Requirements:

- Ericsson Certified Professional - IP Transport Design
- Juniper Networks Certified Enterprise Routing and Switching Specialist
- F5 Certified Technology Specialists
- Cisco CCNA
- Extreme Certified Specialist

## Recommended by LinkedIn

The Importance of Digital Transformation in Network… Abdullah AlSuaybi PhD, MBA, PMP®, PRINCE2®, MSP®,CSM®,APTD® 3 years ago

Leading the Future of 5G Technology with Network… Fariha H. 2 years ago

5G “Sliced-Edge” Architecture: Enabling 8 business… Ashish Kar 5 years ago

## What´s in it for you?

Here at Ericsson, our culture is built on over a century of outstanding decisions. With us, you will no longer be dreaming of what the future holds – you will be redefining it. You won’t develop for the status quo, but will build what replaces it. Joining us is a way to move your career in any direction you want; with hundreds of career opportunities in locations all over the world, in a place where co-creation and collaboration are embedded into the walls. You will find yourself in a speak-up environment where empathy and humanness serve as cornerstones for how we work, and where work-life balance is a priority. Welcome to an inclusive, global company where your chance to create an impact is endless.

## What happens once you apply?

To prepare yourself for next steps, please explore here:

Feel free to apply and include resume in English, outlining how you meet the specific requirements of the position.

The selection and the interview process is ongoing. Therefore, send your application in English as soon as possible.

Location: Stockholm, Sweden

If you have any further questions, you are welcome to contact us.

Recruiter: Isha Vashishtha(isha.vashishtha@ericsson.com)

Kindly note we do not accept application send via e-mail.

We encourage the opportunity to meet you!

Do you believe that an organization fostering an environment of cooperation and collaboration to execute with speed creates better business value? Do you value a culture of humanness, where fact based decisions are important and our people are encouraged to speak up? Do you believe that diverse, inclusive teams drive performance and innovation? At Ericsson, we do.

We provide equal employment opportunities without regard to race, color, gender, sexual orientation, transgender status, gender identity and/or expression, marital status, pregnancy, parental status, religion, political opinion, nationality, ethnic background, social origin, social status, indigenous status, disability, age, union membership or employee representation and any other characteristic protected by local law or Ericsson’s Code of Business Ethics.

# Senior Manager, Risk

#### HSBC Tel Aviv District, Israel לפני ‏1‏ ‏שנה‏ להיות בין 25 הראשונים מועמדים ראה מי HSBC שכר עבור תַפְקִיד זה כבר לא מקבלים בקשות

- דווח על עבודה זו

הודעה ישירה פוסטר עבודה מ HSBC

### Priyanka Reddy

#### Management | HRM | Diversity and Inclusion | Linguistics and Culture

ההודעה Priyanka Reddy

At HSBC, we’re a trusted international organisation with a global customer base of around 39 million customers worldwide through a network that covers 62 countries and territories. In Europe, our ambition is to become the leading international wholesale bank and we need talent like you to help us meet our ambition. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top or in an exciting new direction—we offer opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

Here in Israel, you’ll help evolve and grow our business. Are you a thinker? Do you have the ability to make difficult decisions? Do you enjoy resolving problems?

If you answered yes to any of these questions, we want to hear from you!

What you will do:

This is a role within Risk & Compliance Function in HSBC Israel will oversee and manage various aspects of financial and non-financial risks work streams while ensuring overall alignment with global policies and local regulation.

The job holder will report locally to the Chief Risk and Compliance Officer (CRCO) and will establish strong partnership with the country business and functional teams as well as regional stakeholders, acting with them to drive the implementation of policies and ensure safe growth.

In this role you will:

- Support the business in the achievement of its sustainable growth aspirations, by protecting and enabling the business through appropriate risk management discipline; ensuring risks are captured, understood, and clearly communicated to key internal and external stakeholders as required.
- Provide independent advice, support, and challenge the different country lines of business under Group's risk strategy and appetite (ensuring alignment with local regulation) and support management of key exposures.
- Proactively identify, assess, and provide a forward-looking view on top and emerging risks and issues within the Risk Map, developing mitigating strategies where necessary
- Support CRCO in overseeing the country’s overall risk portfolio, providing judgement, challenge and analysis of risk and reward, ensuring exposures are managed in a consistent and systematic way in accordance with the parameters set by the country’s Risk Appetite Framework
- Overseeing implementation of strategic risk related to projects and the overall Risk and Compliance transformation agenda in country.
- Support CRCO in managing the relationship with relevant regulators.

You should apply if you have:

- Role holder must be located in Israel with fluent business English and Hebrew.
- Previous 7+ years' work experience in Control / Risk / Audit / Compliance roles.
- Proven banking experience with an understanding of banking activities, products, processes, and systems.
- Sound understanding of the different risk areas.
- Strong knowledge of regulatory environment in the financial services sector.
- Able to conceptualize the operational impact of business change.
- Strong communication, presentation and influencing skills.
- Ability to understand complex concepts and provide streamline solutions.
- Relevant academic degree.

Even if you feel you do not fit 100% of our qualifications, we encourage you to not let this hold you back from applying if you believe this is the role for you.

What you’ll get in return:

- We’ll help you progress your career, including access to development programmes, mentoring and coaching, as well as world-class training through HSBC University
- You can work your way and will have a say in when, where and how you and your team flexibly work together
- You’ll have opportunities to work internationally - this can be your place to start and branch out to anywhere we have offices
- You’ll be able to join our Employee Resource Groups that bring together colleagues with shared characteristics and common interests.

For further information on building your career at HSBC, please visit: www.hsbc.com/careers

### 职位职责
1.深度洞察北京市场需求，识别新产品、新功能及新市场切入机遇。  
2.主导北京移动大市场产品体系规划，制定清晰的产品战略与发展路径。  
3.追踪分析AI技术演进趋势，前瞻性制定未来发展规划与技术应用路线。  
4.负责产品全生命周期管理，高效匹配资源保障各阶段目标达成。  
5.建立产品规模、收入等核心指标监控体系，市场洞察-产品规划-落地试试端到端驱动产品优化与发展决策。
### 任职资格
1.学历要求：全日制硕士研究生及以上学历，人工智能、市场营销、工商管理、经济学、计算机科学、数据科学等相关专业优先。  
2.工作经历：5年及以上市场研究、产品规划、战略分析或相关领域经验，有大型企业或互联网/科技公司背景者优先，具备北京市场经验者尤佳。  
3.市场洞察力：精通市场研究、用户行为分析、需求挖掘方法论，能精准把握北京市场动态。  
4.产品规划能力：熟练掌握产品规划流程、商业模式设计、产品线规划及战略制定。  
5.技术理解力：对AI、大数据等前沿技术有深刻理解和敏锐度，能评估其业务应用潜力。  
6.数据分析能力：精通数据分析工具（如SQL,Python,R,Tableau等），擅长通过数据监控产品表现并指导决策。  
7.全生命周期管理：具备产品从孵化、上市、增长到退出的全周期管理经验。  
8.商业敏感度：深刻理解业务目标，能将洞察与规划转化为可衡量的商业成果（规模、收入）。  
9.资源协调能力：优秀的跨部门沟通协调与资源整合能力。  
10.卓越的战略思维、前瞻性视野和创新意识；优秀的PPT、Word等材料撰写与总结能力；具备较强的逻辑分析能力、沟通表达能力和抗压能力。

# 中国银行保险信息技术管理有限公司2026年校园招聘公告
中国银行保险信息技术管理有限公司携下属分子公司，正式启动2026年度校园招聘活动，面向国内外普通高等院校诚聘英才。
![](https://campus.51job.com/cbit2026/images/tt1.png)
**2013年7月** ，经国务院批准，**中国银行保险信息技术管理有限公司** （简称中国银保信）正式注册成立，注册资本20亿元，总部设在北京，由国家金融监督管理总局直接管理。中国银保信主要负责建设和运营全国统一的银行业、保险业信息共享系统，提供交易支持、数据治理、风险管理、科技支撑和登记、验证、精算、咨询等服务。截至目前，中国银保信公司下设**3家** 分公司，**1家** 办事处和**1家** 子公司。
中国银保信自成立以来，在金融监管总局的领导下，以高质量党建引领高质量发展，始终坚守初心，践行服务行业发展、支持银保监管、保护金融消费、辅助社会治理等多重使命。依托智能化综合性数字信息基础设施和安全可控、稳定可靠的安全体系，中国银保信积极利用大数据、云计算、人工智能、区块链等现代信息技术，相继建成生产支撑类、业务登记类和主题应用类信息共享平台达到**10余个** ，各类系统**100余个** ，形成了大型生产系统的管理和支撑能力，以及大数据集中管理、统一应用、深入挖掘、价值转化等能力。
中国银保信坚持从银行保险业丰富应用场景和共性发展需求出发，积极探索银行、保险行业及跨行业的信息共享模式，充分挖掘数据价值，广泛连接行业机构，携手各方打造开放融合的金融科技新生态，服务范围覆盖**农村普惠金融、汽车产业生态、大健康产业、风险管控、金融合规、信息技术服务** 等领域，助力银行保险机构防范化解金融风险，赋能银行保险业数字化转型，推进社会治理现代化。
中国银保信将持续深入贯彻新发展理念，不断深化改革，加快创新发展，优化业务格局，认真履行服务监管、服务市场两个职责，研发更多贴近监管、符合市场的科技产品和数字服务，为助力数字中国建设贡献力量。

### Eric Laffont
#### Chief Security Officer @ ESSP
Published Dec 31, 2017
[+ Follow](https://www.linkedin.com/signup/cold-join?session_redirect=/pulse/keyboard-drivers-including-keylogger-installed-default-eric-laffont&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_publisher-author-card)
This is not yet a referenced CVE (CVE-TBD, PSR-2017-0137) but this feature is present in all the HP laptops and desktop keyboard drivers. According to HP it is only a debug trace purpose that was not removed to the final driver. Ok, perhaps it is true, but it allow to send all the keyboard typed characters to a specific external site.
HP states that we need to be admin to exploit this feature, but it is not completelly true as the flows can be displayed on exit using a capture tool. This still shows that even if it is only a software bug/mistake/error or volontary feature, the need for an outgoing FW like is probably the most important part for an outer protection leaks. Be noticed that the "correction" provided by HP patch will not cover all the affected devices but only the refereced ones listed in HP's support website.
Read the real story here: hxxps://zwclose.github.io/HP-keylogger/
And HP response here: hxxps://support.hp.com/us-en/document/c05827409
Press realease here: hxxps://www.digitaltrends.com/computing/hp-laptops-keylogger-keyboard-driver/

### 我们的优势
##### 全国业务、数据中心、安全防护、组网优势、云计算
## 15年发展历程
北京数据家科技股份有限公司成立于2006年，是专业的互联网综合服务商。数据家致力于提供业界领先的数据中心托管、城域网传输、云计算、大数据等相关业务，建立端到端的网络生态系统。
数据家拥有独立自治域AS号56019，IDC、ISP、VPN、SP等业务相关资质，自主经营5个数据中心，带宽吞吐量高达上千G，北京区域覆盖百余个网络节点，自建及合作链路数千公里，具有良好的网络可靠性和稳定性。
数据家具有丰富多样的高品质产品，为1000余家企业客户提供高品质数据中心托管服务，为百万级终端用户提供高速的带宽接入和数据传输服务，是品质优秀的互联互通网络平台。
## 14年发展历程
#### 物理隔离
数据家采用多网络架构体系，通过不同的物理设备将各体系中出口、核心、汇聚层的网络设备进行隔离；
#### 网络隔离
同网络架构，应用不同的 IP 地址段，在同一运营商的不同区局互联网出口进行 IP 地址宣告，实现互联网出口独立且隔离；
#### 互联网出口冗余
互联网出口冗余。通过向运营商出口宣告不同粗细的路由方式，实现同一运营商的不出口出现故障（光缆、模块、设备等）的自动冗余；
#### 客户隔离
将 IDC 用户分布到相互独立的网络架构体系中，降低故障风险影响范围；
#### 路由协议
路由协议．全网应用动态路由协议（ b gp 、 ospf 、 isis ) + bfd 技术，实现故障链路的毫秒级切换；
#### IPV4 / IPV6 
完成下一代互联网技术（ IPV6 ) ，为用户提供 IpV4 / IPV6 双协议栈部署解

title: Electronic Signatures
description:
Electronic Signatures

Agree & Join LinkedIn

By clicking Continue to join or sign in, you agree to LinkedIn’s User Agreement, Privacy Policy, and Cookie Policy.

## Executive Summary

A number of our clients have reached out to us asking what the best way to evidence approval is electronically and remain in compliance with SOX / Bill 198. We’ve listed all the ways that we’ve seen electronic approval and ranked them in terms of risk. From an internal control’s perspective, all these ways have been accepted in the past as sufficient, appropriate evidence of approval. However, going forward, organizations may want to standardize the way in which electronic approvals are used to reduce risks of cyber fraud.

## Electronic vs. Digital Signatures

> An electronic signature is an electronic symbol attached to a contract or other record, used by a person with an intent to sign. In contrast, digital signatures guarantee that an electronic document is authentic. What’s important to know is that both electronic and digital signatures are binding [in the US and Canada]. – DocuSign

It’s important to note that a digital signature or certificate is a sub-set of the broader e-signature family where e-signatures also encompass digital images of signatures or when someone uses a stylus to sign on a tablet, for example.

Obtaining a digital signature from a certificate authority (CA) and using it to approve digital documents has the highest level of security. This is because the certificate purchased can be verified.

The most important thing to note with these options is that every signature or method of approval needs to be validated in some way. Physical signatures are administered in a controlled environment, so the steps required to validate them are usually minimal. When it comes to e-signatures, the environment is less controlled as documents can easily be forwarded and copied, so the risk of forgery can be greater. E-signature validation can be done by a third party with digital signatures/certificates, but with most of the methods discussed, it’s usually done by the person receiving the signature.

Please refer to Appendix A for the E-Signature Validation Decision Tree

Please refer to Appendix B for steps on how to create, receive and validate self-signed digital signatures in Windows and Adobe.

Please refer to Appendix C for steps on how to electronically sign a PDF document in Adobe Acrobat Reader

## Electronic Signature/Approval Tool Matrix

In the matrix below, we’ve listed several ways to electronically sign or approval documents.

## Digital Signatures

Digital signatures are the most secure form of electronic approval as they provide a unique certificate as evidence of approval. The certificate can be issued by a third-party where details of the signor are validated, or they can be a self-signed certificate that users can add to their trusted certificate list which helps ensure that future documents are authentic.

An additional layer of security is that once a digital signature is applied to a PDF, Microsoft Office document or email, the document cannot be altered without invalidating the signature; something that the user would be notified of when opening the document.

## Digital Signature Issued by Certificate Authorities

Digital signatures or digital certificates can be purchased from Certificate Authorities. The certificate assures users that the signature is valid and is trusted by Microsoft, Adobe, etc. Certificate Authorities require documentation to validate a person’s identity (e.g. email address, name) or the company they work for.

Certificates are purchased and then installed on devices or tokens. Users can add the certificates to Microsoft Office files, PDFs or emails to help prove they are authentic. These digital signatures show up as being valid and can be immediately trusted as the Certificate Authority has already performed the validation.

The cost varies depending on the CA but is approximately $100 to $400/user/year.

## Self-Signed Digital Certificate

A middle-of-the-road approach would be to use a self-signed digital certificate. This approach requires the user to create a Windows Digital ID with their information in it and then use this to sign PDFs or MS Office documents such as Excel, Word or PowerPoint. When the digital certificate is sent to someone for the first time, they have to validate the sender and then trust the certificate. Once the certificate is trusted using Adobe and Microsoft applications, it will not have to be trusted again.

The benefit of using certificates is that additional software does not need to be installed, and documents don’t need to be uploaded to the cloud or other applications. The downside is these will not likely be as trusted by external parties and are a little complicated to setup. Refer to Appendix B on how to create a self-signed digital signature.

## Electronic Signature Software Solution

Electronic signature services (e.g. Adobe Sign, DocuSign) are workflow platforms that allow users to send a document for signature. The person receiving the document can draw their signature with their hand or stylus, upload a signature file or digitally sign with a certificate.

## Adobe Sign

Adobe Sign is cloud subscription service that allows users to upload signatures and sign them. Documents that are signed through this service can be validated. A banner appears at the top of the document and additional information can be viewed in the signature pane. The banner assures the user that the signor used Adobe Sign to sign the document. This in combination with receiving the document through email provides a sufficient assurance that the signor is who they say they are.

*Note that Adobe uses the word "certified" and not "valid signature" as Adobe does not validate who signs the document.

The cost starts at USD $9/user/month

## DocuSign

Similar to Adobe Sign, DocuSign is a cloud-based e-signature solution with the main difference being that they are also a Certificate Authority (CA) and can issue digital certificates for users who sign documents using the DocuSign Express Digital Signature. This adds an additional layer of security.

The cost starts at USD $10/user/month.

## Electronic Signatures

Other ways to electronically sign documents is to use a feature like Adobe Fill & Sign in PDF documents or to place a digital picture of a signature

Adobe Acrobat Reader (free version) allows users to electronically sign documents either by typing, drawing or uploading an image. This is a lower level of security as it can be performed by anyone who has either an electronic or physical copy of the agreement but can be suitable if it is received from a trusted source.

Also note that documents that are signed in this manner can be altered after being signed which does not invalidate the signature. When documents are digitally signed, they cannot be altered, or the signature will be invalidated. This makes documents signed in this manner slightly less secure. However, validation procedures can be performed to ascertain the authenticity of the document. Please refer to our validation procedures decision tree for further details.

Refer to Appendix C for how to insert an e-signature into a PDF document.

## Adobe Stamps

Adobe Acrobat Reader (free version) also allows users to stamp a document as “Reviewed” or “Approved”. Identity information is copied into the stamp along with the computer’s time. As shown below, identity information can be easily changed in the Preferences section, so the source of the file should be taken into consideration when trusting the stamp. The time information on the stamp cannot be altered and can be trusted.

### Appendix A – E-Signature Validation Decision Tree

## Appendix B

### Creating a Windows Digital ID

There are several ways to create a Windows Digital ID, but the easiest way is through Adobe Acrobat Reader, a free software that most users have installed on their computers.

Access Adobe Acrobat Reader by clicking on a PDF file (make sure it doesn’t open in a web browser) and go to Edit | Preferences or hit CTRL + K

Go to the Signatures category on the left-hand side and select the More button for Identities & Trusted Certificates

Click the Add button

Select A new Digital ID I wan to create now and hit Next

Select Windows Certificate Store for the storage option and hit Next

Fill in your information and leave defaults for Key Algorithm and Use Digital ID for fields and hit Finish

### Digitally Signing a PDF

To digitally sign a PDF using your digital ID, do the following

Open the PDF using Adobe Acrobat Reader

On the right-hand side, select More Tools

Select Certificates

Select Digitally Sign from the top middle of the page

Highlight a rectangular area by clicking and holding your mouse where you would like to place your digital signature and what size you’d like it to be

Select your digital certificate and hit Continue

Configure your signature by selecting the Edit button

Configure your signature by selecting what information you’d like to appear and either drawing your signature or uploading a picture image of it. Avoid typing or leaving it blank as that raises suspicion.

Hit Save

Select Lock down document after signing if you do not want any further changes to the document

Hit Sign

Acrobat will ask you to save the file as a new version with your signature.

### Digitally Signing MS Office Documents

Once you have your digital ID, it’s easy to sign Microsoft Office documents. There are two ways to sign:

1) Invisible signing – i.e. where you don’t see a signature

2) Regular signing – i.e. where you insert a signature line and digitally sign

### Invisible Signing

To invisibly sign a MS Office document, perform the following steps:

Select File, then Info then Protect Workbook and choose Add a Digital Signature

Select a Commitment Type and then ensure that you are signing as yourself. If this is the first time, you’re signing an MS Office document, you might have to hit Change and select the certificate that has your name. Additional details can also be added, if desired.

The first time you use your digital ID, you’ll get the following error. Ignore and hit Yes

Hit Sign

After you sign, the document will show as Marked as Final meaning if any changes are made, the signature will be removed.

The document will also say that it contains Recoverable Signatures this means that you haven’t trusted the signature yet. To trust the signature, click View Signatures…

In the signatures pane, select Signature Details…

Select Click here to trust this user’s identity. This will trust your own digital ID which will prevent future prompts and signature errors.

You’ll note that the Signature Details will now say the signature is valid

### Inserting a signature line in a MS Office document

Inserting a signature line should be used when a document is intended to be signed by another user such as a supervisor or manager. In this scenario, the person creating the document inserts who they want to digitally sign before sending it for approval. To insert a digital signature line, follow the steps below:

Select Insert from the ribbon, then Text | Signature Line | Microsoft Office Signature Line

Insert Signor Details and hit OK

A signature line will be created. When the document is sent to the intended signor, they will right click on the signature line and select Sign

The signor can then either sign with a stylus or mouse or upload an image file with their signature. Similar to invisible signing, the signor can select their digital ID before hitting Sign

Right clicking on the signature and selecting Signature Details shows that the signature is valid

## Receiving a document that was digitally signed

When receiving a file that has been digitally signed, it’s the responsibility of the user to validate the signature. If the document is being received directly from the person signing via internal email, then that is sufficient to conclude the digital signature is valid. Alternatively, if the document is saved in a restricted workspace that the signor along with limited other users, then that is also sufficient to conclude that they signed the document.

When receiving a document that’s been signed for the first time, the user has to select that they trust the signor’s ID. Once this is done, going forward, the signature from that person should appear as valid. If a document is signed by that user, and the signature is invalid, then steps should be taken to ensure the document is authentic.

### Receiving an MS Office document that was digitally signed

If the source of the document can be trusted, then the user can navigate to the signature details and opt to trust the user’s identity.

### Receiving a PDF document that was digitally signed

Similar to MS Office documents, the person receiving the document from another user for the first time must verify that the source of the document is valid. Once this is determined, the user can trust the ID by doing the following:

Right click on signature and select Show Signature Properties

Click on Show Signer's Certificate...

Review information and conclude whether the document was received from the person

On the Trust tab, select Add to Trusted Certificates

Select Certified documents and hit OK

Click Validate Signature and the signature should appear as VALID

## Appendix C

## How to electronically sign a PDF using Adobe Acrobat Reader

On the right-hand side of the PDF or from the Tools menu, select Fill & Sign

Select Fill and Sign again on the next page

Select Sign from the top of the document and then Add Signature or Add Initials

Select Draw to draw your signature or Image to upload a picture of your signature

Select Apply and place your signature on the document.

description:
# Hello Everyone, There are openings for Technical Specialist (CNS P&E PE CSF R&D) in Nokia. | Nitin Soni · LinkedIn · 2025-01-29

**Nitin Soni**: Solution selling specialist at Nokia with 16 years 8 months of experience. Previous roles include Network Architect at Nokia, Network Planning & Design at Jio, and Network Solution Sales (DWDM OTN SDH) at Huawei Technologies. Based in Greater Bengaluru Area [IN].

---

Hello Everyone,
There are openings for Technical Specialist (CNS P&E PE CSF R&D) in Nokia.
Location: Bangalore
Experience - 6 to 8 Years
Skills Required:
Must Have:
• Strong proficiency in Java and Spring Boot 3.
• 6-8 years of experience in software design, development, and testing.
• Experience with persistence frameworks like EclipseLink and JDBC.
• Experience with container orchestration tools like Kubernetes and Helm charts.
• Familiarity with SNMP protocols and SNMP4J library.
Good To Have:
• Good understanding of OAM concepts.
• Experience with message queues like RabbitMQ and Kafka.
• Experience with high availability solutions like JGroups.
• Experience with authentication and authorization mechanisms like OAuth and Spring Security.
• Experience with build tools like Gradle.
• Experience with packaging applications as RPM packages and building Docker images.
• Experience with React, Redux, and OIDC for UI development.
• Strong communication, collaboration and debugging skills.

If interested please share your updated resume to nitinsoni307@gmail.comI highly recommendCFBRGreat opportunity

title: American Express is hiring for Director-Compliance (10+YOE)-25016711 for Gurgaon location | Kirandeep Singh
description:
# American Express is hiring for Director-Compliance (10+YOE)-25016711 for Gurgaon location | Kirandeep Singh · LinkedIn · 2025-09-14

**Kirandeep Singh**: Regulatory Compliance Manager at American Express with 10 years 10 months of experience. Previous roles include Senior Compliance Officer Regulatory Change Management Program office at American Express, Compliance officer Compliance Risk Assessment Program office at American Express, and Lead Business Analyst at American Express. Based in Gurgaon, Haryana, India [IN].

---

American Express is hiring for Director-Compliance (10+YOE)-25016711 for Gurgaon location

The Director of Compliance is responsible for first line regulatory-related advisory across regulatory change management, materials review, privacy, controls and issue management, as well as reporting on key compliance metrics. This role ensures business practices align with internal compliance policies and applicable regulatory expectations. The Director plays a hands-on role in operationalizing compliance requirements and embedding a strong culture of compliance within the business.

How will you make an impact in this role?

Serve as the Compliance subject matter expert and provide day-to-day regulatory advisory to business units across products, services, and operations.
Support the development and execution of sustainable processes within the business for managing compliance-related issues, including remediation and restitution efforts, in partnership with Compliance and Risk stakeholders
Collaborate with key stakeholders to develop and implement compliance governance, including documentation standards and supporting system implementation.
Support audits and regulatory examinations by providing business-level compliance input, documentation.
Interpret and communicate applicable regulatory changes and assist with their implementation within business functions.
Provide compliance input on business issues and support development of effective remediation strategies.
Integrate industry best practices, emerging trends, and regulatory developments into the business compliance approach
Contribute to compliance reporting, risk monitoring, and insights shared with business leadership.

Qualifications:
10+ years of experience in risk management within the financial services industry, with significant compliance and regulatory experience.
Strong knowledge of applicable laws, regulations, and industry standards. Understanding of risk management principles, frameworks, and regulatory requirements
Proven expertise in banking and/or credit regulatory compliance, with demonstrated ability to translate regulatory requirements into actionable business guidance.
Understanding of regulatory frameworks, including consumer protection (UDAAP, ECOA, FCRA, EFTA, TILA, etc.) and compliance management systems preferred
Professional regulatory compliance certification preferred (CRMC, CAMS, CCEP, CIP)
Bachelor’s degree in law, Compliance, Business, or a related field. Master’s degree preferred.

title: allianz partners china
description:
安联世合中国官网

核心价值

产品和服务

安联世合的顾客实验室（DataLab）能够洞察顾客的行为和心理。据此打造丰富顾客旅程的解决方案。

消费者洞察

我们默默地守护您的顾客和员工的日常生活，无论他们是在家里享受悠闲时光、在办公室里忙碌工作，还是在旅途中奔波，我们助力让生活更加顺畅、便捷。

全天候解决方案

我们在全球70多个国家和地区开展业务。在200多个国家和地区拥有一个由超过 140万家救援合作伙伴组成的强大网络。

全球足迹

*基于安联世合全球数据统计

我们的 AI远程健康解决方案—Emma，提供 24/7 全天候健康建议。该平台不仅有助于加深顾客关系，而且可以满足顾客旅途中的新需求。

一位车主在西藏自驾游时车辆意外发生故障，情况危急，我们的技术顾问远程提解决方案，帮助车主成功脱困。

一位10岁的儿童在偏僻小岛上陷入昏迷。疫情管控的限制意味着我们无法将她转运至澳大利亚，因此我们决定将其转运至奥克兰。

5月26日，安联集团旗下专注救援与保险服务的安联世合（Allianz Partners），携手安联人寿保险有限公司与京东安联财产保险有限公司，共同发布了中文版《2026安联全球旅行信心指数》（2026 Allianz Global Travel Confidence Index）。

阅读全文

安联世合（Allianz Partners）日前宣布与2026年米兰-科尔蒂纳冬奥会和冬残奥会达成战略合作，推出创新的票务保障计划，旨在为即将到来的冬奥会及冬残奥会观众的购票投资提供风险保障。

阅读全文

安联世合中国成功通过国际职场性别平等权威评估 - EDGE认证。这标志着公司自2022年首获认证、2024年通过再认证后，在推动职场平等与包容方面再次获得国际权威认可，彰显了其在构建公平职场环境上的持久承诺与扎实进展。

## UBS CYBERSECURITY AWARENESS PLATFORM

## Решения и сервисы для эффективного повышения осведомлённости в организациях любого масштаба и отрасли.

---

- 35 интерактивных курсов с тестами, заставки, плакаты, дайджесты.
- Брендирование и бесплатная адаптация учебного контента к специфике вашей организации
- В облаке на серверах UBS в РФ или на ваших серверах (on premises)
- Учёт специфики различных аудиторий персонала, гибкая настройка маршрутов обучения
- Простой настраиваемый интерфейс с многоязычной поддержкой
- Доступны плавающие лицензии
- Управление через веб-интерфейс любыми браузерами с любых устройств
- SSL-шифрование, интеграция с LDAP, AD, IDM, SIEM и SOC, поддержка SSO
- Техподдержка 365x24x7 на русском и английском языках по email и телефону, время реакции – 2 часа

- Имитация фишинговых атак (санкционированные антифишинговые рассылки), USB-пентесты, прозвон с провокацией раскрытия конфиденциальной информации и другие пентесты
- Выделенная команда UBS целенаправленно работает над обучением именно вашего персонала с учётом именно вашей специфики
- Полный аутсорсинг – вы не тратите свои ресурсы, в то время как UBS эффективно решает вашу задачу
- Самые последние новшества фишинга – отслеживаем и реализуем их для вас, вместо вас
- Сообщения с любыми вложениями и ссылками на фейковые сайты на специально приобретённых спуфинговых доменах

- Разработка методологически верной корпоративной системы повышения осведомлённости в области ИБ с использованием всего спектра каналов и методов доставки информационно-обучающего контента
- Интерактивные мультимедийные курсы, разработанные профессиональными консультантами по ИБ, любого графического оформления с профессиональным озвучиванием
- Графические мультимедийные материалы: плакаты, памятки, скринсейверы, видеоролики, видеоуроки и игры по ИБ
- Организационно-распорядительная, методологическая и методическая документация для повышения осведомлённости по ИБ
- Офлайн-тренинги, инструктажи, квесты и корпоративные дни кибербезопасности

ПОДРОБНЕЕ >>

## Объединённая металлургическая компания повышает осведомлённость персонала в области информационной безопасности с помощью UBS Cybersecurity Awareness Platform

https://ubs.ru/publications/ubs_articles_omk.html

Многокомпонентное решение UBS Cybersecurity Awareness Platform будет использоваться АО «ОМК» как для обучения сотрудников правилам обеспечения информационной безопасности с помощью системы дистанционного обучения UBS LMS, так и для практической отработки навыков отражения фишинговых атак с использованием сервиса пентестов методами социальной инженерии UBS PhisherKiller™.

## UBS приняла участие в VII международной научно-практической конференции "Декабрьские Дебаты", организованной экономическим и юридическим факультетами МГУ им. Ломоносова и Национальной Ассоциацией Комплаенс при поддержке аудиторско-консалтинговой группы ФБК Grant Thornton

https://ubs.ru/publications/ubs_articles_dd.html

В секции "Кибердебаты" конференции также приняли участие компании Ростелеком, Диасофт, Positive Technologies, FBK Cybersecurity, GoodWAN и другие. Генеральный директор UBS представил презентацию на тему "Формирование корпоративной культуры кибербезопасности как способ контроля киберрисков, связанных с персоналом".

## UBS вошла в обзор Forrester 20 поставщиков решений для повышения осведомлённости в области информационной безопасности

https://ubs.ru/publications/ubs_articles_forrester.html

В обзоре "Now Tech: Security Awareness and Training Solutions, Q1 2019" Forrester предлагает сегментацию поставщиков по размеру выручки и полноте охвата их решениями основных направлений и методов повышения осведомлённости.

## Трубная Металлургическая Компания повышает осведомлённость персонала в области информационной безопасности

https://ubs.ru/publications/ubs_articles_tmk.html

В 2017 году в Трубной Металлургической Компании был инициирован комплексный проект по повышению осведомлённости персонала компании в области информационной безопасности. Партнёром по реализации данного проекта стала консалтинговая компания UBS.

## Как для реализации программы повышения осведомлённости персонала заручиться поддержкой руководства

https://ubs.ru/publications/ubs_articles_senior%20management%20support%20for%20security%20awareness%20program.html

В этой статье мы посмотрим, как наименее болезненно и наиболее эффективно можно решать жизненно важный для самой идеи повышения осведомлённости персонала вопрос: как заручиться поддержкой руководства?

## Повышение осведомлённости персонала в области информационной безопасности: несколько практических советов

https://ubs.ru/publications/ubs_articles_security%20awareness%20practical%20recommendations.html

Предлагается ряд практически значимых советов относительно того, как сделать повышение осведомлённости эффективным и «живым» процессом обеспечения и поддержания информационной безопасности в организации.

## Summary

A range of Unilever products being used, as well as advertising lifestyle imagery.

## Detailed description

The text “Creating Desire at Scale” appears. The overall look is clean and modern. The curved, white U-shaped design element of the Unilever “U” branding is present throughout the video.

A smiling woman with voluminous wavy brown hair appears large in the centre of the screen. She is wearing gold earrings, two thin gold necklaces and a brown vest top. She has a tattoo on her left shoulder.

The camera quickly moves past her to the left, almost through her hair, with the light briefly dazzling the view.

A woman opens a sachet of white Liquid I.V. Hydration Multiplier powder and sprinkles the contents into a glass of water. She is wearing a white vest top and a green and pink cardigan. The woman is wearing a gold necklace and two thin gold rings. The water and powder swirls around in a glass, fanning out to the edge of the screen. The camera zooms in on orchid flowers tumbling through water, with vibrant yellow, white and red swirling patterns. This scene is largely blurred.

A close-up of a blue flower appears, each petal is shown in detail.

The frame then switches to a colourful food dish, filled with rice, chicken pieces, tomatoes, courgettes, diced red onions and chopped green herbs. Small red tomatoes are thrown in the air, followed by roasted courgettes over a flame.

A smiling woman with long, brown hair wearing purple pyjamas falls in slow motion onto a bed with pink bedding in a brightly lit room. The room features teal panelled walls, a colourful wavy-patterned headboard, and large windows with yellow curtains. There are also hanging spherical lights, a plant near the window, and a cityscape visible outside. As the woman falls onto the bed, we see a vibrant explosion of multicoloured powder and flowers bursting across the room.

A woman with blonde hair lathers a bar of white soap around her shoulders. She places a bar of Dove soap onto a blue tray.

We then see three women smiling, dancing on the spot and spraying whole-body deodorant over themselves, all in unison. They are in an outdoor square with café tables and a large tree in the background. The woman at the front of the three wears a cream top and blue trousers. One woman in the background wears a white bra top and faded jeans. The other wears a black top and shorts, and has extensive visible tattoos. Two other women, further in the background, dance across the view, from right to left.

A variety of images fly around the screen, including a red teapot and a yellow rubber duck. The image then swirls into a vortex and a bottle of Cif Infinite Clean all-in-one spray comes into view.

We then see an open pouch of Knorr Cheddar Broccoli Rice Sides from below. The background is multicoloured vibrant reds, greens and oranges. The pouch looks like it is being shaken and rice is erupting from the top. The rice grains are then close up, flying in slow motion through the air.

A hand appears squeezing a lemon, followed by a man’s face leaning in to smell the aroma from a steaming cooking pot. He has dark brown hair and a moustache.

A close-up of two eyes, and a woman’s face come into frame. She has long brown hair, tied up in a ponytail. She’s wearing red lipstick and a gold chain. She’s holding a product in her hands.

Viewed from above, a small gold jar of Hourglass Veil Translucent Setting Powder falls in slow motion onto a black surface, causing an explosion of light-coloured powder from under it.

The next frame shows red powder being scooped up.

A water droplet falls from the petal of a white and yellow flower onto a purple and yellow petal. There’s a close up of a pink flower, covered in water droplets.

A thin white U-shaped line art appears overlaid throughout the video.

No audio and no captions available

title: 我在 NIKE 的官網上買了一雙鞋，全世界這個型號只有這一雙。 鞋子就是「黑金」設計，黑色為主色，佐以金黃色的線條。 整雙鞋幾乎看不到 NIKE 的 Logo，因為 LOGO 也是黑色的，但卻用金線縫了「HL」兩個字，乍看會以為這個鞋牌子是「HL」，還想說是什麼新牌子？其實「HL」只是「Happy Lee」的縮寫，就是我本人，Happy 的鞋。 | 李昆謀

title: IKEA企業業務部很榮幸於五月份和環境部資源循環署、環興科技共同舉辦「綠色設計工作坊」，邀請了各縣市環保局，以及多家公部門夥伴一起交流歐盟最新生態設計規範 、循環經濟與綠色採購等議題。 活動中，我們分享了IKEA的永續策略，以及家具租賃服務等循環商業模式，透過家具配置、維護和回收等服務，延長產品生命週期。IKEA也介紹了與環境部、國家檔案局、台電及台北101等租賃合作案例。 看到台灣持續推動綠色設計、循環服務與綠色採購等政策很令人鼓舞，《資源循環推動法》也展現與國際趨勢接軌的重要一步。這是一場充滿交流、收穫與瑞典下午茶 FIKA ☕️ 的精彩工作坊，也再次提醒我們：循環經濟不只是選項，而是共同的未來。 | IKEA

title: 近日，理想汽车创始人李想对特斯拉销量点评的对话记录在网上流传。在这份对话中，李想就反思、分析了为什么一堆国产车卖不过特斯拉model 3的原因。 是因为品质吗？ 特斯拉向来被人所诟病的就是做工，手指一般宽的缝隙、动辄罢工的车机系统等等都是很多消费者吐槽的热点，而特斯拉这样做工和品质其实在10万元以下的国产车如今都已经很难看到了。更不用说，特斯拉model 3还曾经爆出过“芯片缩水”的丑闻，其品质实在让人难以放心。 | Yingchen Wu
